activation: explicit startup injection only; not imported by current production shared entry
interpolation_status: designed authoritative logical-pixel reconstruction, not verified original rendering interpolation
duration_source: client_verified SNPCMoveTo signed32 positive milliseconds; original animation divides by1000
mask_status: command supplies a proven or explicitly designed server mask0..255; no player packet or automatic NPC movement-mode guess
budget_status: designed per-map-command work bounds, not game balance or commercial capacity proof
arrival: server monotonic end time; advance returns stable generation/request/key event IDs once; no asset write or wire duration0
interruption: rebase to current server position and cancel previous arrival; retries never restart the timeline
